item.title: perf(ci): shard Control UI E2E by measured duration, not source bytes
item.summary: perf(ci): shard Control UI E2E by measured duration, not source bytes checks-ui-e2e now owns the CI wall: in run 32617320781 its seven slowest shards ran 199-245s while the tallest compact node job was 182s. The sequencer already does greedy longest-first bin packing -- it was just weighting by source bytes as a "zero-state duration proxy", and that proxy is too weak. Across 247 suites bytes correlate with wall time at r=0.79 and mispredict by 3.6x (0.20-0.73 s/KB), so the packer filled one shard to 182s against a 130s ideal while another took 86s. Hint the 30 slowest suites with measured seconds and keep the byte proxy for the long tail, whose 3.5s median file is interchangeable. Replaying the real per-file durations through the packer: widest shard 171s -> 137s. With ~63s of per-job overhead that is roughly 245s -> 200s on the tallest ui-e2e job, at which point checks-ui (199s) becomes the pole, so this is worth ~45s of wall and no extra runners. Durations are medians over runs 32617320781 and 32617488420, each normalized by its own VM speed first; the two runs agreed within p10 0.88 / p90 1.17, so the per-file numbers are stable rather than one noisy sample. Unhinted files still
